scope: native Windows DACL descriptor mismatch investigation

probe.command: go test ./internal/store/sqlite -run TestProbePrivateDACL -count=1 -v; go test ./internal/watch -run TestProbePrivateDACL -count=1 -v

observed_after_apply_private_dacl.ace_shape: exactly one allow ACE granting FA to the current-user SID

comparison.current_normalization: replaces D:P with D:, leaving AI and producing D:AI(A;;FA;;;<CURRENT_USER_SID>)
comparison.result: mismatch caused solely by the reported AI control flag

semantic_assessment.reason: The observed descriptor has the expected owner and exactly one full-access ACE for that owner. P/AI are DACL control metadata, not additional principals or ACE grants. Application must continue requesting PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION when setting the DACL.

recommended_minimal_fix: In both sqlite and watch validatePrivateDACL, compare owner plus canonical DACL ACE content while accepting the benign reported P/AI control flags; do not weaken applyPrivateDACL or accept extra ACEs/principals.
